title.text: 4. Structured summary: Tracking progress made in implementing and achieving the NDC under Article 4 of the Paris Agreement a

label.text: Mitigation GHG Emission Levels for Electricity Sector

progress.text: Egypt has achieved remarkable success in transitioning to low carbon pathway in the electricity sector (generation, transmission, and distribution) with a substantial GHG emission reduction of 47,810 GgCO2e in 2022, with a decrease of 34.34% in emissions  compared to BAU levels for that same year.  Egypt’s electricity sector is advancing steadily towards the 2030 target of 37% overall GHG emission reduction.

title.text: 4. Structured summary: Tracking progress made in implementing and achieving the NDC under Article 4 of the Paris Agreement a

label.text: Mitigation GHG Emission Levels for Oil & Gas Sector

progress.text: Egypt has made significant progress in the recovery and utilization of associated gases produced from crude oil fields. Efforts in the oil and gas sector have resulted in a cumulative GHG emission reduction of 1,351 Gg CO2e in 2022, with a decrease of 57%  in emissions compared to BAU levels for that same year. The associated gases subsector of Egypt's Oil & Gas industry is on track to achieve the 2030 target of a 65% overall GHG emission reduction, with significant progress already made.

title.text: 4. Structured summary: Tracking progress made in implementing and achieving the NDC under Article 4 of the Paris Agreement a

label.text: Mitigation GHG Emission Levels  for Transport Sector

progress.text: Egypt has achieved outstanding success to adopt more sustainable low carbon modes of transport with a substantial 13,200 GgCO2e in 2022 with a decrease of 16.86% of emissions  compared to BAU levels for that same year. This has surpassed the 2030 target of 7% overall GHG emission reduction. This positive trend was since 2015 and continued till 2022 due to multiple policy interventions, such as energy subsidy reform program, and other influencing factors that led to behavioral changes in road transport.

verdict.text: The registry's current submission for this Party is Egypt’s Updated First Nationally Determined Contribution 2030 (Second Update), filed 2023-06-26. 49 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (3). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 385 MtCO₂e, DS-35 332.5 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. It submitted BTR1. 3 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 45.4 for 2024. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.27°C under SSP1-2.6 to +5.22°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
